_meta.title: Paradiso — 귀화면접 참고 영상/자료 (비공식)
_meta.purpose: Seed registry of user-provided reference playlists/channels for the 참고 영상/자료 section. Metadata-only by design.
_meta.youtubePolicy: No transcripts, captions, or full lesson text are scraped or stored. transcript_stored is always false. Titles are not fabricated: where a playlist/channel title was not retrieved through permitted metadata, the title field is an explicit human-written placeholder noting the title is unconfirmed. If a YouTube Data API key becomes available, only official metadata endpoints (playlistItems/list, videos/list) may be used to enrich this seed.
_meta.requiredCardLabelKo: 영상 자료는 비공식 참고자료이며, 실제 면접 질문 또는 법무부 공식 기출문제를 의미하지 않습니다.
